text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
From the 4th corner into the long, long homestretch!!
Who will become the Queen of the Oaks?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, she can still run like that
even at this distance...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Like hell I'm gonna let you pass————no way in hell!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The queen is... MEEEEEEEE!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's Lucky Lilacccc!!
She pulls ahead!!! She takes the lead!!
It's Lucky Lilac!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac--!!
Crossing the finish line in 1st place!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She refuses to surrender the throne!!
Displaying sheer pride, it's Lucky Lilac!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations, Lucky Lilac!!
Still, that was one amazing race...!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Almond Eye was amazing too,
but Lucky Lilac's race management was just better this time around...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I won—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Over the classic distance,
I actually won...! I won!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I am the true Queen of the Oaks...!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Damn it...!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You outdid me...!
Even after preparing my stamina, I still lost...!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Our real match will be at the Shuka Sho!!!
I'll get way stronger over the summer and definitely win!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Impressive as always.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Her spirit ain't broken in the slightest.
She ain't thinkin' about nothin' but winnin' next time.
...What kind of mental fortitude is that?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...At the end of the day, it's not about being super fast or anything like that.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(The scariest thing about this girl
is that unyielding, unbreakable fighting spirit of hers.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ai-san bridged the gap in raw talent today
through sheer unyielding fighting spirit alone.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And next time, I'm sure
she'll overcome all sorts of things with her sheer grit...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(To keep challenging like that over and over until she wins.
That's Ai-san. But you know――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I ain't gonna lose, no way.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
As the queen, I will stand tall and face Ai-san head-on.
And I will win the next one too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...You like it better that way, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
That's the spirit, Lara!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. Thank you very much
for your support today as well.
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
You're zoning out, is something wrong?
choice_data_list: No, I just really think you're cool.
No, I was just thinking how truly cool you are.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what's this out of the blue?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you hold your head
high too, ya hear?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
After all, we're the duo that won the URA Best Dresser Award.
...Come on, let's stand together.

I puff out my chest. As the trainer of a queen,
I must stand tall and proud, without a trace of shame.

...And together, they rejoice.
In the glory of the Oaks, now in their hands—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Finally, next is the final Tiara,
the 2000m turf 'Shuka Sho' at Kyoto...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Riding this momentum, I'll definitely win the next one too...!
With Trainer and me together, we can do it...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Once more, please don't hold back as we head toward the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"With that fighting spirit, Ai-san will definitely
be my greatest rival next time, too.
...I've gotta make sure she doesn't catch up to me."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's stay focused and keep working hard!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no.
...I just thought my shoelaces were a bit loose.
Must've been imagining things.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...There's no pain. And it doesn't feel like fatigue either.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Even so, just now... my body felt kind of weird... like it was tensing up.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...If this keeps happening, I should talk to Trainer.
For now, I'll just keep an eye on it—)

As the days leading up to the Shuka Sho began,
a faint presence was quietly emerging—
